pr_title: [Feature] add synthetic mode for speculative decode
source_quote: In Triton JIT kernels, it is highly recommended to use the bitwise/logical operator `&` instead of Python's short-circuiting `and` operator, even for scalar values. This ensures consistent behavior and avoids potential compiler-specific optimization bugs or compilation failures across different Triton versions on Ascend.

rule.description: 在 `@triton.jit` 装饰的 kernel 函数内部，所有合成 boolean 条件（mask 合并、条件比较结果组合、accepted/rejected 标志）一律使用逐位/逻辑运算符 `&`（and）、`|`（or）、`~`（not）。即便对于"纯 scalar、Python 语义下 short-circuit 也完全等价"的写法也禁止——Triton 编译器可能对 `and`/`or` 产生保守分支、或产生 backend 不能处理的 IR 节点，从而引发跨版本编译失败或生成错误代码。
checkpoints: 扫描所有 `**/ops/triton/**/*.py` 文件中的 `@triton.jit` 函数体
正则 grep: `\band\b|\bor\b|\bnot\b` 在 jit kernel 内的使用（需排除字符串注释 / `#` 行尾注释）
重点检查 `if cond1 and cond2:`、`accepted = cmp1 and cmp2`、`mask = valid1 and valid2` 这种组合 boolean 的位置
若包含 `accepted = ... & mask`、`accept_mask = (draft == target) & mask` 这种"一半位运算、一半 Python 逻辑"的混合写法，必须整体改为位运算

antipattern.code:
@triton.jit
def rejection_greedy_sample_spec_len_1_triton(
    # ... 参数列表 ...
    uniform_probs_ptr,
    synthetic_conditional_rates_ptr,
    draft_token_ids_ptr,
    output_ptr,
    n_tokens: tl.constexpr,
    SYNTHETIC_MODE: tl.constexpr,
):
    offset = tl.program_id(0)
    mask = offset < n_tokens
    draft_token_id = tl.load(draft_token_ids_ptr + offset, mask=mask, other=-1)

    if SYNTHETIC_MODE:
        uniform_prob = tl.load(uniform_probs_ptr + offset, mask=mask, other=1.0)
        rate = tl.load(synthetic_conditional_rates_ptr + 0)
        # Python short-circuit `and` — 在 Triton JIT 中不安全
        accepted = (uniform_prob < rate) and (draft_token_id >= 0)
        tl.store(output_ptr + offset, draft_token_id, mask=accepted & mask)
    else:
        # 非 synthetic 分支已使用位运算
        accept_mask = (draft_token_id >= 0) & mask
        tl.store(output_ptr + offset, draft_token_id, mask=accept_mask)

pattern.code:
@triton.jit
def rejection_greedy_sample_spec_len_1_triton(
    # ... 参数列表 ...
    uniform_probs_ptr,
    synthetic_conditional_rates_ptr,
    draft_token_ids_ptr,
    output_ptr,
    n_tokens: tl.constexpr,
    SYNTHETIC_MODE: tl.constexpr,
):
    offset = tl.program_id(0)
    mask = offset < n_tokens
    draft_token_id = tl.load(draft_token_ids_ptr + offset, mask=mask, other=-1)

    if SYNTHETIC_MODE:
        uniform_prob = tl.load(uniform_probs_ptr + offset, mask=mask, other=1.0)
        rate = tl.load(synthetic_conditional_rates_ptr + 0)
        # ✅ 使用位运算 & 替代 Python and
        accepted = (uniform_prob < rate) & (draft_token_id >= 0) & mask
        tl.store(output_ptr + offset, draft_token_id, mask=accepted)
    else:
        # 非 synthetic 分支保持位运算风格
        accept_mask = (draft_token_id >= 0) & mask
        tl.store(output_ptr + offset, draft_token_id, mask=accept_mask)
